wheelchair_availability: Accessible ramp paths and level main pathways suitable for personal wheelchairs and walking frames.Wheelchair accessibility varies across different temple structures, with primary sanctums accessible through assistance.
priority_darshan: Direct logistical assistance paths provided to ensure minimal standing times for senior citizens. Security staff and temple guards are available along the barricades to physically assist and guide frail devotees.
ramps_and_lifts: Ramp paths integrated within the main premises. Main temple pathways and courtyard are level flat ground, suitable for personal wheelchairs and walking frames.
guidelines: Vehicle Drop-Off: Cars can drive down Temple Road to drop senior citizens directly at the main entrance gate before parking. Senior citizens should avoid visiting during Sharad Navaratri due to exhausting outdoor waiting times.
